thread:
carmen: Heads-up: we saw a recurring 503 cluster-wide for embedding service under heavy tail traffic. I have a minimal hotfix ready (model-embed v2.4.0-hotfix). Requesting an express cut in the 04:10-04:20 UTC change window.

phil: can you summarize the rollback plan and why we should skip canary?

carmen: TL;DR: race in async flush path causing transient OOMs on a small proportion of host threads. Fix is a guard + backoff (single-file change). Staging load tests with 1k rps burst looked good. Canary can hide the issue due to different batching patterns; want staged roll 5/50/100 but skipping 10% canary to avoid parity masking.

lia: PM ack. I'll draft the external bullet and post-release note. Carmen paste the exact deploy command and the 1-line blurb.

carmen: Deploy command: `/deploy pin model-embed:v2.4.0-hotfix --note "hotfix: guard async flush + backoff" --no-canary --force`

ops_oncall: I'll own the rollback gate. Rollback triggers: embed_5xx_rate >1% sustained over 3m OR host_oom_count >0 within the watch window. Also alert on increased GC pause time.

infra_bot: infra_bot: auto-check passed: image signed, binary checksum verified, schema compat OK.

deploybot: Deploybot: deploy slot free at 04:15 UTC. To execute run the pinned command. Confirmers required: @lia @ops_oncall.

lia: Confirmed. Approving expedited deploy for 04:15 slot. I'll post the external blurb after deploy completes.

phil: Quick preflight: `http POST https://int-api/embed/smoke version=v2.4.0-hotfix samples=200`

carmen: preflight returned 0/200 5xxs, p95=140ms (baseline 135ms). Ready to start.

carmen: Kicking off at 04:15. @deploybot run pin. Roll steps: 5% -> 50% -> 100% with 90s watch each.

deploybot: Started rollout at 04:15 UTC. Steps: 5% -> 50% -> 100%. Monitors: embed_5xx_rate, p95_latency, host_oom_count. Live status: https://deploys.internal/1779012345

ops_oncall: 5% step looks clean. No 5xxs. p95 ≈138ms.

phil: 50% step now. small error blip on a single pod, investigating logs: stacktrace shows previously-seen flush race but guard seems to have suppressed OOM.

ops_oncall: still within thresholds. GC pause increased on one host to 350ms but no OOM.

infra_bot: infra_bot: autoscaler removed the noisy instance and replaced it; health checks passed.

carmen: holding between 50% and 100% for 2m to observe.

deploybot: Proceeding to 100% at 04:18 UTC.

ops_oncall: Post-deploy 4m aggregate: embed_5xx_rate = 0.2%, p95 latency = 142ms, host_oom_count = 0. No rollback.

lia: Published external blurb: "v2.4.0-hotfix: mitigates async flush race that could cause transient embedding 503s under burst; backoff & guard applied." Sent to #customers and release digest.

releasebot: Releasebot: changelog entry created: "2026-03-25 7: v2.4.0-hotfix 7: Async flush guard/backoff to address intermittent embedding 503s."

phil: Nice work. Recommend adding a synthetic burst test to CI that simulates the exact batching pattern we saw.

carmen: Agreed. Filing a short follow-up ticket and assigning to infra for simulated-burst test. Thanks all.

lia: Closing loop 44D
